turns.customer: If I return the Breeze Wind Shell from order #1314, do I have to pay for the return shipping?
turns.reply: The return policy doesn't mention return shipping fees. To return the Breeze Wind Shell from order #1314, you can print a return label directly from your account and send the item back unused and in its original packaging. Once the warehouse receives it, they will issue your refund, usually within 5 business days. Let me know if you have any other questions!
